reproduction.dependency: Python standard library and pinned repository JSON only; no scratch files or network
reproduction.startingState: Every case begins from unchanged garden-map.v0.3. No player names, prayer text, cosmetic labels or initial-state variation enter the natural model.
reproduction.entropy: SHA-256 expansion of ASCII quiet-basin-v04|seed={seed}|round={round}|role={mapping/outcome/oracle}|block={block}; weather uses weatherPeriod={period} instead of round={round}. Decimal ASCII, no leading zeros or newline. Buffers mapping256 / other roles32. Materials match across all five policies for each seed.
reproduction.mapping: One UniformBelow(3) target prelude, including fixed preferences; then unchanged weighted family/recipe draws and Fisher-Yates from the same buffer cursor.
reproduction.seedPolicyCycle: cycle_three is a fixed development input sequence: inlet rounds1..3, shade4..6, meadow7..9, repeating. Every preference is supplied before preparation; no additional player preference enum.
reproduction.exactState: Compare actual tuples for cellIds0..255: surfaceWater,soilWater,evaporationRemainder,meanLight,plantGrowthOrNull,plantGrowthRemainderOrNull. Hashes are diagnostic; comparisons are not based on run IDs or hash uniqueness.

coarseState.puddle: Final non-solid cell surfaceWater>=120; a state threshold, not a claim that PuddleFormed fired this round.

seedReachStatic.meaning: Static upper bound only. Greedy seed selection, scatter needing two empty cells, chosen recipes and site history may leave cells unoccupied. This is not a demonstrated maximum or a normal-play guarantee.

legacyRegression.scope: Original four anchors only; derived kernel regression, not independent physics verification.

inputOrderCases.meaning: Same two inputs and 80 ticks, reversed order. Clear weather is forced for this controlled natural-model fixture; no normal journal or oracle events are generated.

candidateAcceptance.meaning: Predeclared G2 arithmetic candidate criteria only. No seed exclusion, outcome adjustment, rendering quality judgement or uniqueness guarantee.

notCovered: journal durability, queued preference and recovery
complete event aggregation and oracle predicates/selection
acceptanceMeaning: Physical reference diversity under fixed materials only; collisions are retained and all cases are reported. No claim of infinite unique gardens, real-player frequency or confirmed visual quality.
